case.failure_mode: SFTP connections unconditionally used ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey(), allowing an active man-in-the-middle to impersonate the configured replica host.

phase_b.selection_semantics: Union every candidate unit whose frozen_fix_position is at most 10 for the target fix, review each selected unit once, and review every fix edge carried by that unit.

protocol.negative_policy: Insufficient evidence and unreviewed candidates are not negative labels.
